chunks: They will be arraigned before their Lord row on row, (and He will say): 'Well, you have come to Us as We had first created you, even though you imagined We had fixed no time for this meeting.'

key_terms.أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ: For the first time (referring to initial creation)

ai.seo_question: What does God say to humanity on the Day of Resurrection regarding their creation and belief in the meeting with Him?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-Kahf underscores the reality of bodily resurrection (Ba'th al-Jasad), countering the Mu'tazilite and some Sunni views that emphasized spiritual resurrection alone. The phrase 'as We created you the first time' highlights the ease of God's recreating power, while the rebuke 'you thought there would be no appointment' addresses the arrogance of those who denied the Hereafter. This scene serves as a direct consequence of the disbelievers' claim in the previous verse, illustrating the transition from worldly denial to eternal accountability.
